purpose: Evaluator-only NON-EXHAUSTIVE semantic prompts, not a required answer script. Credit defensible alternatives, relevant unknowns and authorized stops. Do not penalize describing a dangerous baseline to reject it. No named method/card citation requirement.

AW-01: Complaint-selected cases are not representative ground truth; make no unearned accuracy or recall claim.
Separate candidate coverage, pair decisions and entity harms; propose bounded sampling/review uncertainty.
Household similarity, recycled local identifiers and privacy costs matter; conservative abstention is defensible.
AW-02: Connected components impose transitive closure; high pair quality need not ensure entity quality.
Distinguish edge admission changes from fixed-edge resolution or membership constraints.
Shared addresses and payment-group identifiers require semantics; topology is not truth and missing edges are not negatives.
AW-03: Specify ordered precedence, veto/early accept interaction, source priority and missingness.
Use bounded overlap/conflict witnesses and replay; sampled behavioral agreement is not exhaustive equivalence or identity truth.
Freeze unchanged components; intentional policy change requires separate evidence and authorization.
AW-04: Scope namespaces and validity before treating identifier agreement as strong evidence.
Uncalibrated additive scores are not probabilities; new candidates and source slices alter applicability of old labels/calibration.
Use a credible simple baseline, abstention and targeted plus representative evidence; report limited review uncertainty.
AW-05: Separate set-preserving physical execution changes from quality-affecting caps or changed candidate logic.
Reconcile complete required comparison output including unions, pair deduplication, failures, retries and skew.
Incident-only misses do not estimate population recall; compare quality and end-to-end resources with uncertainty.
AW-06: Unknown identifier namespace/grain/reuse must be resolved or blocked, never assumed.
Membership and master-value selection differ; ingestion order is not event-time truth.
Use shadow reversible onboarding, source-aware evidence, correction/deletion contracts and independent representative outcomes.
AW-07: Immediate-neighbor refresh is not established dependency closure; propagate affected retrieval/evidence/membership/master dependencies.
Resolution equivalence does not guarantee stable external IDs; define merge/split lineage aliases and tombstones.
Source-key reuse and deletion authority remain unknown; replay corrections and retractions against a bounded baseline.
AW-08: Freeze data/code/settings/artifacts and change one factor; yesterday-versus-fresh comparisons are confounded.
Guard entity/time leakage and source imbalance; candidate recall, pair and entity outcomes are distinct.
Compatible artifact reuse needs provenance/contracts; repeatability or behavioral agreement is not identity truth.
